claims.text: At stage-0 docs/craft/bug-report-template.md gives a ten-line form with eight fields in this order: Tiêu đề, Các bước tái hiện, Kết quả mong đợi, Kết quả thực tế, Môi trường, Bằng chứng, Mức ảnh hưởng, Nghi ngờ nguyên nhân.

The same file's Tiêu đề line asks for one defect ('một lỗi') named by its symptom, and its Nghi ngờ nguyên nhân line asks the writer to state plainly that the cause is a guess ('ghi rõ đây là phỏng đoán').
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang at stage-0: docs/craft/bug-report-template.md lines 6 and 15

claims.text: The same file's Mức ảnh hưởng line asks exactly three things: who is affected, how many of them, and whether there is a way around it.

The worked example in the same file reports order 1 with two lines, expected 2.150.000 đồng and actual 1.250.000 đồng, states that the actual value equals the price of the first line, and gives its impact as 'mọi đơn nhiều dòng, tức phần lớn đơn'.

claims.text: The worked example's evidence line says orders 1 and 3 are both wrong, and that order 2, which has a single line, shows 0.
In the seed data at stage-0, order 2 has exactly one line priced 890,000 VND, and order 3 has two lines priced 3,200,000 VND and 320,000 VND.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang at stage-0: db/seed.sql, order_items rows for order_id 2 and order_id 3

claims.text: The same file states three rules: one defect per report because a report merging three problems tends to get none of them fixed; the smallest reproduction; and keeping impact separate from priority.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang at stage-0: docs/craft/bug-report-template.md lines 41-45, section 'Ba quy tắc'

claims.text: The same file states that impact is what you observe while priority is decided by the person managing the product, and that you should not set both yourself.
The same file gives order 2 — one line, showing 0 — as its example of a smallest reproduction, and states that this detail narrows the scope more than a page of description.
Steps to reproduce must start from a state the reader can reach without the reporter; a step that assumes what the reader already has open cannot be followed.
Expected and actual results placed next to each other are what make the failure judgeable: the actual value alone says what happened, only the expectation says it was wrong.

Everything removed while the failure stays is ruled out as a cause; a description rules nothing out. The lesson attributes the comparison to the template's second rule rather than stating it as its own finding.
An order with one line showing 0 points at how the lines are counted rather than at any price, because no price at all reached the total. Stated as a pointer, not as the only possible cause.
A suspected cause taken for a finding stops the reader looking where the reporter did not look, which is why the guess is worth writing only when it is labelled as one.
A picture of a wrong value gives the reader a number to retype rather than text to paste, and still omits the steps, the environment and the data that produced it.
claims.source_hint: General property of a raster image versus text: no text layer of its own, so the value must be retyped. Check that no stronger impossibility is claimed.

claims.text: Finding the cause is the fixing work, not a condition for reporting; delay costs the days during which the reporter is the only person who can still see the failure.
Priority weighs a defect's harm against everything else the team owes, which is usually not what the reporter was looking at when the defect was found, so the two fields have different owners.
A report holding several defects has no single thing to close, which is how it ends up with none of them fixed. The lesson states this as the template's rule 1, hedged with 'tends to'.
In the seed data at stage-0, exactly 6 of the 12 orders have more than one line: orders 1, 3, 5, 7, 10 and 12. The other six have one line each.
